# package udp

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/pubsub/transport/udp"
```

Package udp is the UDP transport of OPC UA PubSub (Part 14 §7.3.2): UADP NetworkMessages in UDP datagrams, unicast or multicast, IPv4 or IPv6.

Importing the package registers the "opc.udp" scheme with [transport.Register](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/pubsub/transport#Register).

#### Addresses {#hdr-Addresses}

The URL of a connection is opc.udp://host:port; the port is required.

  - A multicast group (opc.udp://239.0.0.1:4840, opc.udp://\[ff15::1]:4840) is the destination of Send. Subscribe binds the port on the wildcard address (or Config.ListenAddress) with SO\_REUSEADDR and SO\_REUSEPORT, so that several subscribers on one host can share it, and joins the group on Config.Interface (the system default if empty). Datagrams are sent with Config.MulticastTTL (default 1) out of Config.Interface, and loop back to this host unless Config.MulticastLoopback is false.
  - A unicast address is the destination of Send. Subscribe binds that address and port (or Config.ListenAddress), so it must be local.
  - "localhost" and an empty host (opc.udp://:4840) select the wildcard address for Subscribe ("receive all", as open62541 does); Send to "localhost" goes to 127.0.0.1, an empty host cannot be sent to.

Config.Interface is an interface name ("eth0") or one of its addresses. An IPv6 zone in the URL (\[ff02::1%eth0]) selects the interface too.

Sending uses its own socket bound to an ephemeral port; the receiving socket is opened by the first Subscribe. All subscribers of a connection get every datagram the connection receives.

## Constants

```go
const (
	MaxDatagramIPv4 = 65507
	MaxDatagramIPv6 = 65527
)
```

Largest UDP payloads: 65535 minus the IP and UDP headers.

```go
const Scheme = "opc.udp"
```

Scheme is the URL scheme of the UDP transport.

## Types

	// invalid: cannot send

Conn is a UDP PubSub connection.

#### func Open

```go
func Open(ctx context.Context, cfg transport.Config) (*Conn, error)
```

Open opens a UDP connection for cfg.URL. It resolves the address and opens the sending socket; the receiving socket is opened by Subscribe.

#### func (Conn) Close

```go
func (c *Conn) Close() error
```

Close closes the sockets and waits for the receive goroutine to end (unless it is called from a handler, which runs on that goroutine).

#### func (Conn) LocalAddr

```go
func (c *Conn) LocalAddr() net.Addr
```

LocalAddr returns the address of the receiving socket, nil before the first Subscribe.

#### func (Conn) MaxMessageSize

```go
func (c *Conn) MaxMessageSize() int
```

MaxMessageSize is the largest payload Send accepts.

#### func (Conn) Send

```go
func (c *Conn) Send(ctx context.Context, payload []byte, _ transport.PublishOptions) error
```

Send transmits one datagram to the address of the connection.

#### func (Conn) Subscribe

```go
func (c *Conn) Subscribe(ctx context.Context, _ string, _ byte, h transport.Handler) (func() error, error)
```

Subscribe delivers every datagram received on the connection's address to h. topic and qos are ignored. The first Subscribe opens the receiving socket; a bind or join error is returned here.
